Orthodoxy has no single confessional document beyond the Creed and the councils; catechisms and expositions show how the faith is taught, and speak for their publishing jurisdiction, not for all Orthodox churches. The Confession of Dositheus is a local synod of 1672 whose authority Orthodox theologians later qualified, and the English text quoted here is Robertson's 1899 translation as reproduced on a private site, not by an Orthodox jurisdiction.
